release_read.basis: Q3 beat clearly on every line (revenue $343.6m vs $329.8m consensus, VMM $94.9m above the $88-93m guide, adj EBITDA $39.6m vs $34-36m) and FY EBITDA was raised to $151-153m from $145-152m, but the Q4 revenue guide of $315-325m sits about $20m below what the old FY guide implied, the FY revenue top was trimmed, and a $98.8m goodwill charge flags a weak segment; on a name sold on forward quality twice, that nets to a modest positive with wide uncertainty.

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast (brief fallback, 2 estimates); not like-for-like: GAAP includes a $98.8m non-cash goodwill charge, adjusted EPS not read in the time available

key_line.metric: Insurance segment revenue and the Q4 guide
key_line.detail: Insurance $234.9m, +15% YoY (the peer-read thesis). Q4 guide revenue $315-325m, VMM $88-93m, adj EBITDA $34-36m: revenue midpoint ~$320m against ~$340m implied by the prior FY guide; Q4 EBITDA midpoint ~$35m against ~$36m implied.

guidance.detail: Mixed. FY adj EBITDA $151-153m (was $145-152m) and VMM $370-375m (was $364-374m) raised; FY revenue $1.30-1.31bn (was $1.30-1.32bn) trimmed at the top, so implied Q4 revenue is lowered despite the Q3 beat.

call.detail: Call held last night at 16:30 ET; its content (tone, Q4 revenue explanation, goodwill segment) was not found or reviewed in the time available.

public_reaction.summary: One search for post-release analyst actions and coverage returned only older-year items; no Q3 2026 price-target change or reaction headline found by 09:20 ET. Tones set neutral for lack of evidence.

thesis_check.note: The insurance-led revenue beat and EBITDA beat came in as the peer read (MediaAlpha, EverQuote) predicted; the soft Q4 revenue guide and goodwill charge are the counterweight the judges flagged as profit/forward-quality risk.

expected.open_lag_note: Pre-market is stale (4 prints, last 08:53) and the gap is small (~1.3% robust), so the open could land anywhere from flat to +3%; that is uncertainty, not direction. An amc gap usually gives a little back in the first half hour, and the soft Q4 revenue guide is the line a session can re-read against the stock.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers over het derde kwartaal waren sterk en de winstverwachting voor het jaar is verhoogd, maar de omzetverwachting voor het vierde kwartaal is zwakker en er is een grote afschrijving; dat kan in de loop van de dag tegen het aandeel werken. De positie staat al ruim in de winst sinds de aankoop, en er is geen goede reden om af te wijken van de vaste regel: verkopen bij de opening.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als voor 09:30 meerdere analisten hun koersdoel duidelijk verhogen en de voorbeurskoers met veel transacties boven $30 komt, is vasthouden tot 10:00 of een limietorder het overwegen waard.
